context: M9 o4. Royal Cafeteria, Eighth & 40th. The woman in the oxblood dress, coffee and pie, waiting.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You're new. The old collector smelled like aftershave and debt.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'm told you have something for Mayhew.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I have something for whoever Mayhew sends. Tonight, apparently, a gentleman.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Fifty. In an envelope I'd like back. Rule four: never give them the envelope.

choices.text: Count it in front of her.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Go ahead. Count. I'll time you.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You didn't count. Either you're stupid or you're something else.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Moore. Delphine Moore. Go on. Your sergeant's waiting.
